--CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_tranship_pairs AS

WITH Cranes AS (
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        ('PQC34','T1'),('PQC33','T1'),('PQC32','T1'),
        ('PQC31','T1'),('PQC30','T1'),('PQC29','T2'),
        ('PQC28','T2'),('QC07', 'T2'),('QC08', 'T2'),
        ('QC02', 'T1'),('QC01', 'T1'),('QC23', 'T1'),
        ('QC20', 'T1'),('QC33', 'T1'),('QC34', 'T1'),
        ('QC30', 'T1'),('QC31', 'T1'),('QC32', 'T1'),
        ('PQC27','T2'),('PQC26','T2'),('PQC25','T2'),
        ('PQC23','T1'),('PQC21','T1'),('PQC20','T1'),
        ('PQC08','T2'),('PQC07','T2'),('PQC06','T2'),
        ('PQC05','T2'),('PQC04','T2'),('PQC03','T2'),
        ('PQC02','T1'),('PQC01','T1'),('QR01', 'T1'),
        ('QC25', 'T2'),('QC26','T2'), ('QC29','T2'),
        ('QC27', 'T2'),('QC28','T2'), ('QC03','T2'),
        ('QC04', 'T2'),('QC05','T2'), ('QC06','T2')
    ) AS c (CraneId, TerminalShort)
),

Yardblocks AS (
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        ('1A','T1'),('1B','T1'),('1C','T1'),('1D','T1'),
        ('1E','T1'),('1F','T1'),('1G','T1'),('1H','T1'),
        ('1J','T1'),('1Q','T2'),('1R','T1'),('1S','T2'),
        ('1T','T2'),('1V','T2'),('1Y','T2'),('1Z','T2'),
        ('2A','T1'),('2B','T1'),('2C','T1'),('2D','T1'),
        ('2E','T1'),('2F','T1'),('2G','T1'),('2H','T1'),
        ('2J','T1'),('2L','T2'),('2R','T1'),('2S','T2'),
        ('2N','T1'),('3A','T1'),('3B','T1'),('3C','T1'),
        ('3D','T1'),('3E','T1'),('3F','T1'),('3L','T2'),
        ('3M','T2'),('3N','T1'),('3P','T2'),('3Q','T2'),
        ('3R','T1'),('3S','T2'),('3T','T2'),('3V','T2'),
        ('3Y','T2'),('3Z','T2'),('4A','T1'),('4B','T1'),
        ('4C','T1'),('4N','T2'),('5N','T2'),('CZ','T2'),
        ('GD','T1'),('GE','T1'),('GF','T1'),('KD','T2'),
        ('SC','T1'),('WA','T1'),('WB','T1'),('WC','T2'),
        ('WE','T2'),('XA','T1'),('XB','T1'),('XC','T1'),
        ('XD','T1'),('XE','T1'),('XF','T1'),('XG','T1'),
        ('XH','T1'),('XJ','T1'),('XK','T1'),('XL','T1'),
        ('XM','T1'),('XR','T1'),('PA','T1'),('1N','T1'),
        ('ONS','T1'),('BR','T1')
    ) AS y (YardBlock, TerminalShort)
),

enriched AS (
    SELECT
        m.mve_gkey,
        m.Unit_Nbr,
        m.Event_Type_Id,
        m.t_put,
        m.Carrier_Visit_Key,
        m.Category_Id,
        m.Freight_Kind_Id,
        m.pow,

        CASE
            WHEN m.From_Position_Name LIKE 'Y-%'
            THEN SUBSTRING(
                    m.From_Position_Name,
                    CHARINDEX('-', m.From_Position_Name,
                        CHARINDEX('-', m.From_Position_Name) + 1) + 1,
                    CHARINDEX(' ',
                        m.From_Position_Name + ' ',
                        CHARINDEX('-', m.From_Position_Name,
                            CHARINDEX('-', m.From_Position_Name) + 1) + 1)
                    -
                    CHARINDEX('-', m.From_Position_Name,
                        CHARINDEX('-', m.From_Position_Name) + 1) - 1
                 )
            ELSE NULL
        END                             AS From_YardBlock,

        CASE
            WHEN m.To_Position_Name LIKE 'Y-%'
            THEN SUBSTRING(
                    m.To_Position_Name,
                    CHARINDEX('-', m.To_Position_Name,
                        CHARINDEX('-', m.To_Position_Name) + 1) + 1,
                    CHARINDEX(' ',
                        m.To_Position_Name + ' ',
                        CHARINDEX('-', m.To_Position_Name,
                            CHARINDEX('-', m.To_Position_Name) + 1) + 1)
                    -
                    CHARINDEX('-', m.To_Position_Name,
                        CHARINDEX('-', m.To_Position_Name) + 1) - 1
                 )
            ELSE NULL
        END                             AS To_YardBlock

    FROM OPENROWSET(
            BULK 'silver/moves',
            DATA_SOURCE = 'malta',
            FORMAT = 'DELTA'
         ) AS m
    WHERE m.[Year]        >= 2026
    AND   m.Category_Id   = 'TRSHP'
    AND   m.Event_Type_Id IN ('UNIT_DISCH', 'UNIT_LOAD')
),

enriched_with_terminals AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        c.TerminalShort                 AS Crane_Terminal,
        yf.TerminalShort                AS From_Terminal,
        yt.TerminalShort                AS To_Terminal
    FROM enriched e
    LEFT JOIN Cranes     c  ON e.pow            = c.CraneId
    LEFT JOIN Yardblocks yf ON e.From_YardBlock = yf.YardBlock
    LEFT JOIN Yardblocks yt ON e.To_YardBlock   = yt.YardBlock
),

trshp_moves AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Unit_Nbr
            ORDER BY t_put ASC
        )                               AS move_seq
    FROM enriched_with_terminals
),

disch AS (
    SELECT * FROM trshp_moves
    WHERE Event_Type_Id = 'UNIT_DISCH'
),

load AS (
    SELECT * FROM trshp_moves
    WHERE Event_Type_Id = 'UNIT_LOAD'
),

paired AS (
    SELECT
        d.Unit_Nbr,
        d.mve_gkey                      AS disch_mve_gkey,
        d.pow                           AS disch_pow,
        l.pow                           AS load_pow,
        l.mve_gkey                      AS load_mve_gkey,

        -- Discharge details
        d.t_put              AS disch_datetime,
        d.Carrier_Visit_Key             AS disch_vessel,
        d.Crane_Terminal                AS disch_crane_terminal,
        d.To_Terminal                   AS disch_yard_terminal,
        d.To_YardBlock                  AS disch_yard_block,

        -- Load details
        l.t_put              AS load_datetime,
        l.Carrier_Visit_Key             AS load_vessel,
        l.Crane_Terminal                AS load_crane_terminal,
        l.From_Terminal                 AS load_yard_terminal,
        l.From_YardBlock                AS load_yard_block,

        d.Freight_Kind_Id,

        -- Dwell time in hours
        DATEDIFF(HOUR,
            d.t_put,
            l.t_put
        )                               AS dwell_hours,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.Unit_Nbr
            ORDER BY d.t_put ASC
        )                               AS tranship_sequence

    FROM disch d
    INNER JOIN load l
        ON  d.Unit_Nbr = l.Unit_Nbr
        AND l.move_seq = (
            SELECT MIN(l2.move_seq)
            FROM load l2
            WHERE l2.Unit_Nbr = d.Unit_Nbr
            AND   l2.move_seq > d.move_seq
        )
)

SELECT
    p.*,

    CASE
        WHEN p.disch_crane_terminal <> p.load_crane_terminal
        THEN 'Cross-Terminal'
        ELSE 'Same-Terminal'
    END                                 AS tranship_type,

    p.disch_crane_terminal + ' → ' + p.load_crane_terminal
                                        AS terminal_flow,

    CAST(p.disch_datetime AS DATE)      AS disch_date,
    CAST(p.load_datetime  AS DATE)      AS load_date,
    YEAR(p.disch_datetime)              AS disch_year,
    MONTH(p.disch_datetime)             AS disch_month,
    DATENAME(MONTH, p.disch_datetime)   AS disch_month_name,
    FORMAT(p.disch_datetime, 'yyyy-MM') AS disch_year_month

FROM paired p;
